items.title: DaVinci Resolve is Getting Faster as Latest Update Boosts IntelliSearch and OGraf Playback
items.rationale: New version: DaVinci Resolve 21.1.2 makes AI IntelliSearch media analysis up to 14x faster on Apple M6 and improves timeline editing. It is a point release editors can install today.
items.excerpt: Blackmagic's DaVinci Resolve 21.1.2 promises up to 14x faster AI-driven IntelliSearch media analysis on Apple M6, along with improved timeline editing and faster OGraf playback.

items.title: SNTPCT Calls for 2-Hour Walkout of French Animation and VFX Workers
items.rationale: New labor action: France's largest animation union has called a walkout for Nov. 18. One of its demands is a GenAI amendment that would stop employers from compelling workers to use or develop GenAI tools. That would set a concrete contract precedent for artists.
items.excerpt: France's majority animation union calls a Nov. 18 walkout pressing producers on pay and a generative AI amendment barring employers from compelling workers to use or develop GenAI tools.

items.title: This AI trick Magically Creates New Camera Angles
items.rationale: Hands-on technique: a demo of generating new camera angles from existing footage. Filmmakers can try it on their next AI project.
items.excerpt: Curious Refuge demonstrates an AI technique for generating new camera angles from existing footage for AI filmmaking.

items.title: The new rules of safety in an era of real-time video generation | Runway AI Summit SF 2026
items.rationale: Primary source: Runway's safety leads explain how moderation works once video is generated in real time. Teams building on these tools learn which content guardrails they will hit.
items.excerpt: Runway's Eliza Jacobs and Conner McDowell discuss safety and moderation approaches for real-time AI video generation at Runway AI Summit SF 2026.

items.title: 브이캣, 일본 TV아사히 사극 '사나다 주유시' AI 영상 제작 참여…넷플릭스 공개
items.rationale: Concrete deployment: Korean AI video studio VCAT produced AI shots for TV Asahi/Toei's 7-part period drama, mixing AI with live action and VFX for hard action scenes. The series airs on TV Asahi and streams on Netflix, so this is generative AI shipping inside a mainstream broadcast drama.
